Documentation.short_help: SHYX Selection Append Patches: Add extracted, pipeline, and shape patches into a PartitionedDataSetCollection.
Documentation.long_help: Snapshots cell selections, pipeline geometry, or parametric box/sphere shapes into the patch table (default names geo_N). Rename only; names need not end with _N. The table keeps every row. Apply merges rows with the same name into one output patch and reuses the earlier mark. Unique names are marked 0, 1, 2, ... in table order (constant cell/field array Mark Array Name, default PatchMark). Selection rows run vtkExtractSelection. Pipeline / box / sphere rows become extra geometry partitions (for SnappyHexMesh regions or any other consumer). Port 0 is the added patches; port 1 is Input minus the union of selection-row cells. With Apply on Add (default), each Add or Remove applies so both ports refresh. Uncheck Apply on Add to skip Apply and allow overlapping picks. Select a box/sphere row's widget in the 3D view to move and resize it.

InputProperty.name: Input
InputProperty.Documentation: Parent mesh. Cell ids in the patch table refer to this dataset.

InputProperty.name: Selection
InputProperty.label: Selection
InputProperty.Documentation: Optional live vtkSelection. Hidden from the default panel: Add from selection reads the 3D-view selection directly (Copy Active Selection is not required). Used when the patch table is empty (single geo_0) or as an Add fallback / Python SelectionInput.

InputProperty.name: CustomPatches
InputProperty.Documentation: Extra pipeline geometries added as patches (one connection per pipeline table row, in table order). Managed by Add from pipeline; not shown as a separate input widget.

StringVectorProperty.name: MarkArrayName
StringVectorProperty.label: Mark Array Name
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Name of the constant cell/field array written on each extracted patch.

StringVectorProperty.name: PatchNames
StringVectorProperty.label: Patch Names
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Newline-separated patch names (table Name column; one line per table row, duplicates kept). Apply merges duplicate names into one output patch and reuses the earlier mark. Unique names are marked 0, 1, 2, ... in first-seen order. Shown via the Patches table, not as a raw text box.

StringVectorProperty.name: PatchCellIds
StringVectorProperty.label: Patch Cell Ids
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Newline-separated cell-id lists aligned with Patch Names. Comma-separated ids or ranges (0-10,15) on the Input dataset. Used by selection rows.

StringVectorProperty.name: PatchKinds
StringVectorProperty.label: Patch Kinds
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Newline-separated kinds aligned with Patch Names: selection (default), pipeline, box, or sphere.

StringVectorProperty.name: PatchParams
StringVectorProperty.label: Patch Params
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Newline-separated extra data aligned with Patch Names. Box: 16-element unit-cube transform (legacy AABB xmin,xmax,ymin,ymax,zmin,zmax). Sphere: cx,cy,cz,radius. Pipeline: display label. Selection rows leave this empty.
